Row.Text: Turns off all GameCore proxy changes at once, without uninstalling it: the game behaves as without the proxy. The other settings are kept, and this tab stays available to turn it back on.
When the game starts, looks on GitHub for a new version of BetterGameExperience, and offers it in the main menu. Takes effect the next time the game starts.

During a cascade of war declarations, city and diplomacy data are refreshed only once, at the end: over 2 s saved on a heavy turn. Does not change the game: safe in multiplayer, even against players without the proxy.
"Every game message" also batches refreshes outside of wars (governors, resources, deals). The interface may then show city data a moment late.
Speeds up the question "can this player build this improvement?", asked millions of times per turn by the AI. Same result as the game, verified with no difference.
Tile yield memory for the AI
Remembers tile yields during the AI's parallel computations, while the map cannot change.
Only with quick combat enabled (Game tab). Speeds up the display during the strike, with no effect on the game.
City and encampment attack buttons, and silo nuclear strike buttons, are drawn above unit flags, where they stay clickable.
Recenter the camera when clicking these buttons
Original game behavior: the camera recenters on the city when an attack button is clicked.
Map pins and their list are no longer rebuilt when nothing changed: fewer slowdowns in multiplayer.
The minimap and the camera cover the whole map from the first turn, without placing map pins at the edges. Unexplored areas stay hidden. Purely local: no effect on other players in multiplayer.
The displayed number of turns includes government bonuses (Fascism, Autocracy, Merchant Republic), like the actual production. Display only.
Wonder kept in the queue after a swap
A wonder removed from the production queue by a swap is put back, through normal game commands: no desync, even against players without the proxy.
Right-click the city banner production to cancel it
A right-click on the production icon of one of your city banners removes the item being produced, like a right-click in the production panel. Normal game command: no desync.
In the production list, districts whose cost is currently reduced (fewer of that district than your average) show their discount, updated as soon as a district is placed. Display only.
Shows the production a city keeps in reserve (overflow, at most one turn), which is added to its production next turn: on the city banner, in the city panel and in the production panel. Display only.
District discount: -{1}% (you have fewer of this district than your average).
+{1} [ICON_Production] in reserve, added to next turn's production (at most one turn of production).
Empire yields updated after a governor or great person
The top bar updates after a governor title, a governor move or a great person, without changing a citizen. Display only: no desync.
Based on Better Builder Charges Tracking (wltk). The flag of a unit with charges (builder, military engineer, Roman legion…) shows them instead of promotions. Replaces the mod if it is active.
The flag of each of your traders on a route shows the number of turns until its trade route ends. The trader then finishes it on returning to its origin city. Display only.
Based on NotificationClear (336tarot). A button in the notification panel dismisses in one click those you can dismiss yourself. Replaces the mod if it is active.

Based on TopPanel Extension Pro (号码菌 / Azukii). Food, production, population, average amenities per city and luxury resources in the top panel, with per-city details; teammates' resources. Replaces the mod if it is active. Without the mod, Better Spectator Mod's top panel is kept.

Based on Extended Policy Cards (Aristos). Each card shows its numeric gain for your empire, computed by Real Modifier Analysis (Infixo), fixed (Raj, Medina Quarter, Monasticism, Civil Prestige, maintenance cards, food on great person cards). No longer needs Better Report Screen. Replaces the mod if it is active.

Based on Better Report Screen (Infixo). Reworked report screen, with Deals, Units, Policies, City-States and Cities tabs, and the effect of each policy and city-state, fixed like the cards. Replaces the mod if it is active.
Writes each interface file read to the proxy log.
Writes to Lua.log how long map pin and leader ribbon rebuilds take.
Writes to Lua.log how long the movement range of a unit standing on an enemy district takes to compute (BGD mouvements lines). Diagnostic only, on this machine.
Writes to Lua.log the deal proposals sent and received, and what the deal screen shows, to understand crossed deals between humans.
Show simultaneous turn start and end signals

With the "No First/Last moves (BGE)" game option, machines exchange hidden chat messages (.bgd_pret, .bgd_depart, .bgd_fin). When on, they stay visible in your chat, with a line when the host ends the turn, to follow each turn start and end. Display only, on this machine.

Records the duration of every zone the game times (frame, interface, scripts, events) to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Civ6RolloverProxy\zones, for performance analysis. About 1 MB per second of play. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
These are the settings of the BetterGameExperience proxies (rollover_proxy.cfg). They will take effect when the next game starts.
These are the settings of the BetterGameExperience proxies (rollover_proxy.cfg). A game has already been started: they will only take effect after restarting the game.
Startup proxy functions missing: settings can be neither read nor saved.
GameCore proxy not installed: these settings will only take effect once it is installed.
Restores every BetterGameExperience setting to its default value.
Reset all BetterGameExperience settings to their default values?
Settings reset to their default values.

Every player starts and ends their turn at the same moment. At the start of the turn, everyone waits until all players have finished loading: you can look at the map, but orders are held and the turn timer does not run. At the end, when the host's turn timer runs out, the turn ends for everyone, even if their own timer still shows time left. Every player needs BetterGameExperience, at the same version. Replaces MPH's turn synchronisation, which is turned off.
All players have BetterGameExperience {1}: POL fixes enabled.
Without BetterGameExperience: {1}. POL fixes disabled for this game.
BetterGameExperience version other than {1}: {2}. POL fixes disabled for this game.

The host does not have BetterGameExperience, or not a compatible version: POL fixes disabled for this game.
{1}: joined without BetterGameExperience (or with another version) while POL fixes are enabled. Their game will desync.
No First/Last moves enabled: every player starts their turn together, and the turn ends for everyone when the host's timer runs out.
No First/Last moves: simultaneous turn start enabled; simultaneous turn end unavailable (exe timer not hooked).
No First/Last moves disabled: every player needs BetterGameExperience, at the same version.

Asks every player which BetterGameExperience version they have, then posts the result in the chat for everyone.
orders held: the turn has not started for every player yet.
turn over: the host's turn timer ran out.
deal not sent: the turn is ending. Send it again next turn.
Spectator: read only, your votes are not counted.
Cancel your end of turn to change your votes. Possible while you have time left and another player is still voting.
Trade route: ends in {1} turn(s), when the trader returns to its origin city.
